headline: Congress in recess mode as both chambers hold only pro forma sessions before Monday return.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened for a brief pro forma session on Thursday, August 20, lasting just 40 seconds before adjourning. No legislative business was conducted as the chamber prepares for a recess period.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House held a three-minute pro forma session on Thursday, August 20, introducing 20 new bills and filing 8 committee reports on various matters including federal funding for museums, antisemitism protections in schools, and water resources reauthorization. No votes were taken.

onTheFloor.title: Authorize the Secretary of the Interior to provide funding for the National Law Enforcement Museum
